title: The substance use disorder treatment gap among US college students: Findings from the 2021 National Survey on Drug Use and Health.
authors: Pasman E, Blair L, Solberg MA, McCabe SE, Schepis T, Resko SM.
tables: Characteristics of college student sample from the 2021 National Survey of Drug Use and Health.
Frequencies (unweighted  n  and weighted %) and Rao-Scott chi-square statistics comparing people not in college with a past-year substance use disorder (SUD) to college students with a past-year SUD.
Bivariate comparisons between college students who met criteria for a DSM-5 substance use disorder (SUD) but did not receive treatment and those who received substance use treatment in any setting.
Logistic regression predicting past-year DSM-5 substance use disorder (SUD) among college students ( n =  6113) .
